description.en: The name of the application group.
The ID of the region. Set the value to cn-hangzhou.

description.zh: 是否保留应用管理创建的资源
description.en:
Specifies whether to retain resources created by application manager when deleting the application. Valid values:
- true
- false

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos delete-application-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name MyApplicationGroup --application-name MyApplication --retain-resource false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos DeleteApplicationGroup --region cn-hangzhou --ApplicationName MyApplication --RetainResource false --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Name MyApplicationGroup
